name: autoresearchclaw-resumable-multi-agent-workflows
instr:
researchclaw cannot resume interrupted benchmark and figure workflows across fresh processes without repeating accepted work. Add recovery that preserves semantic progress, branch or retry position, and cumulative LLM accounting. Pipeline stages retain resumable progress but withhold final artifacts until completion.

Each recoverable invocation returns its established AgentStepResult or raises `AgentSuspended` with a resumable boundary. Records are atomic. Reuse only committed completed boundaries matching context, agent identity, workflow position, and current semantic inputs. Malformed records raise `RecoveryError`; mismatches raise `RecoveryMismatchError`; invalidation forces fresh execution.

SurveyorAgent, SelectorAgent, AcquirerAgent, ValidatorAgent, FigureDecisionAgent, CodeGenAgent, CriticAgent, and IntegratorAgent resume each completed discovery source, filtering, ranking or selection phase, supplied baseline, generated code product, syntax or import check, figure decision or script, review category, and integration entry only while semantic inputs and dependencies match, preserving outputs and issues once in order, completing remaining work, retaining retry associations, and applying requested strict semantics to all combined issues. FigureDecisionAgent and CodeGenAgent identify accepted per-figure decisions and scripts by stable figure identity, so fresh instances complete only outstanding figure work without regenerating accepted work.
